## Workload

During the quarter, grader Priya Anand completed 678 reads over 299 hours. This represents a rate of 2.3 reads per hour. The workload recorded for the period provides a clear basis for assessing throughput alongside the quality review.

## Quality

A sample of 63 reads was checked. The agreement result was 71.4 per cent, providing an indication of consistency between the original and subsequent assessments. The result should be considered with the workload information above when reviewing overall performance.

The review was completed by Priya Anand, who was also the reviewer. No further action is identified for this quarter.
